validation.nodeFixtures: Authored settlement results for exhaustive event progression; two additional real engine scenarios.

browser.note: 552 source files identical during this run; the subsequent offline-shell-only addition in sw.js has its own build verification.

assetProbe.scope: Image HTTP/decode/hash checks, not forty campaign or arena playthroughs.

fullSuite.scope: All 216 test files from the official release collector, no suite aliases counted twice.

limitations: Existing images reused; no newly generated art.
Forty arena/evaluation pairs, not forty newly drawn bosses.
Sequential duel waves with full recovery; no simultaneous horde or standalone mini-game.
Full animated movesets and franchise visual fidelity remain open.
